name: PAN-OS Blocked Non-URL Threat Activity
description: Detects a PAN-OS threat event where the firewall action was to block or drop the traffic and the event was not URL filtering. The blocked or dropped action reduces the chance that the connection completed, but it does not by itself prove that the source or target is safe or compromised.
note:
## What this alert shows

A Palo Alto firewall identified a non-URL threat and recorded a blocked or dropped action. Blocked traffic is not proof of compromise, and the alert does not by itself show whether any earlier or related connection succeeded.

## What to check

Review the source and destination addresses, time, threat name and category, application, destination port, firewall action, security rule, and whether the action was block or drop. Check related events before and after the alert, including allowed traffic, repeated attempts, authentication events, endpoint alerts, and other threat detections. Confirm whether the activity was expected or part of approved testing.

## Safe response

Preserve the relevant logs and escalate unexplained, repeated, or related activity to the SOC and the owner of the affected system. Do not automatically block additional traffic, isolate a system, reset passwords, or disable accounts based on this alert alone; follow the approved incident-response process after confirming the facts and possible operational impact.
author: SOC Manager
false_positives: Authorized security testing or policy validation that intentionally blocks a threat
setup: No deployment changes are required. Validate alert volume and event fidelity after execution.
query: event.dataset:"panw.panos" and panw.panos.type:"THREAT" and panw.panos.action:(drop or block-url) and not event.action:url_filtering
